attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.7.1 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10) via systemd units, opened firewalld ports 2379/2380, and verified cross-member read/write consistency. Demonstrated availability during a member outage (stopped node3, wrote/read via node1+node2 quorum) and confirmed node3 caught up fully on restart. Completed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes, verifying changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each.
